name: Comic Con Russia
blurb: Russia's biggest pop-culture festival in Moscow, now branded jointly with IgroMir, covering film, games, comics and a cosplay contest.

picks: Russian heavy metal band, special guest
Actors presenting The Wizard of the Emerald City film, 6 December

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'Comic Con Игромир — долгожданный фестиваль 03.12 — 06.12.2026 года в Москве!' (title tag also reads 'Comic Con Игромир — фестиваль поп-культуры 2026 в Москве'); venue from homepage text 'Москва, «Тимирязев Центр», станция метро Петровско-Разумовская'.

notes: Site is a single-page Tilda build (comiccon.ru) now titled 'Comic Con Игромир', i.e. Comic Con Russia has rebranded/merged its 2026 event jointly with IgroMir (see igromir.ru, researched separately) rather than running two separate festivals. Homepage JSON-LD was stale (Comic Con Russia 2025, Dec 12-14 2025); used the visible page text instead, which confirms Dec 3-6 2026. No dedicated 'all guests' page exists — guests are announced as standalone homepage promo tiles; picked the real people/acts among them and skipped the Character Alley collab tile and the cosplay-prize-fund tile (not guests). Guest names Евгений Чебатков and Элли на маковом поле are transliterated to Latin; the latter performs under that stage name (real name Victoria Trunova, per vokrug.tv). No organizer name found on the page within budget.
